title: Venn Diagrams
author: 696637e49d26457b33c7eff3
chapter_outcomes: Represent and interpret data in frequency tables and two-way tables.

Represent and interpret data in: pictograms (Drawing of pictograms is not required), bar charts (Simple, sectional, percentage sectional, multiple bar charts), pie charts (Including comparative pie charts), Venn diagrams, box-and-whisker diagrams (Identification of outliers is not required), stem-and-leaf diagrams (Including back-to-back diagrams).
Understand the advantages and disadvantages of different ways of representing data.
